TP: Cortech Tiger Plate Security Wall Plate Covers
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-tp-tiger-series-security-wall-plates
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/facilities-maintenance/tiger-plates/
Spec sheets: TP, Mounting instructions
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Tiger Plate Security Wall Plate Covers – TP
Current H1: Cortech Tiger Series Security Wall Plates - TP
Subtitle: Virtually Unbreakable Molded Wall Plates for Switches, Outlets, and GFI Receptacles, in Single or Double Gang
Current subtitle: None
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Tiger Plate Security Wall Plate Covers cover light switches, outlets, and GFI receptacles in correctional and behavioral healthcare facilities, where standard wall plates are easily broken or pried off. They come in eight single and double gang types.
Each plate is injection molded in one piece from a high strength polycarbonate and nylon blend, so it will not rust or break and never needs painting. The plates are oversized to mount directly to any wall type and to cover the junction box opening and uneven wall surfaces.
Material: One-piece injection molded high strength polycarbonate and nylon blend with a textured finish; 3/16” wall thickness
Sizes: Single gang 3¾”W×5¾”H; double gang 5¾”W×5¾”H (oversized)
Durability: High impact resistance; virtually unbreakable and 100% rust proof
Protective Lip: Side impact lip protects the edges of the plate
Corners: Smooth radius corners
Fastening: Tamper-resistant fastening system; four zinc plated Torx security screws with center pin are included
Color: Smudge resistant white (custom colors available on request)
Wiring Devices: Not included
Care: Stain resistant; clean with a damp cloth
Warranty: 10-year factory warranty
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
Single Gang: TPSS - Single Switch, TPDR - Duplex Receptacle, TPBB - Blank, TPGF - Ground Fault Interrupter Receptacle
Double Gang: TPDBB - Double Blank, TPDD - Double Duplex Receptacle, TPDGF - Double Ground Fault Interrupter Receptacles, TPDS - Duplex Switch
Installation and Options
Mounting: Attach the wiring device to the plate with the tamperproof screws and Nyloc nuts provided, then fasten the plate to the wall with the security screws; use Tapcon concrete screws on concrete walls; see Cortech instructions
Hardware Bit Size: T27 for the corner screws; T15 for the machine screws
[H2] Applications
Tiger Plates suit any area where residents could break or tamper with standard wall plates.
Typical applications include:
Cells, dayrooms, and common areas in correctional facilities and jails
Patient rooms, bathrooms, and common areas in behavioral healthcare facilities
Schools, shelters, and other high-abuse settings
Explore Anchortex's Hardware for Behavioral Health Care Facilities and Prison & Detention Hardware & Equipment collections for more security hardware.
[H2] About Cortech Facilities Maintenance
Cortech facilities maintenance products are molded to stand up to hard daily use in correctional facilities, behavioral healthcare facilities, and other high-abuse settings.
Cortech facilities maintenance includes:
Trash Receptacles: Cobra Cans in 20 to 55 gallon sizes, in flame retardant or food grade and general use material, and Cobra Mini Cans in 10 and 14 quart sizes
Carts: Kangaroo Carts and lids for laundry, trash, and material handling
Secure Waste Bins: The lockable SafeBin with a 35-gallon inner container
Wall Protection: Tiger Plates security wall plates and corner guards
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (58 characters): Cortech Tiger Plate Security Wall Plates - TP at Anchortex
Meta description (160 characters): Shop Cortech Tiger Plates, virtually unbreakable security wall plates for switches, outlets, and GFI receptacles in single or double gang, with security screws.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Facilities Maintenance" is the same section as on the Cobra Can, Mini Can, Kangaroo Cart, and SafeBin pages. I added a "Wall Protection" line for Tiger Plates and corner guards. Would you like it added to those pages too?
H1: Cortech calls them Tiger Plates (security wall plate covers). I took out "Series" and added "Covers."
Variant names: your variants follow the Cortech list, with three differences. TPDR is "Single Duplex" (Cortech: "Duplex Receptacle"), TPDS is "Double Switch" (Cortech: "Duplex Switch"), and the TPSS and TPBB names have an extra hidden space. Would you like them renamed to match Cortech: "TPSS - Single Switch", "TPDR - Duplex Receptacle", "TPBB - Blank", "TPGF - Ground Fault Interrupter Receptacle", "TPDBB - Double Blank", "TPDD - Double Duplex Receptacle", "TPDGF - Double Ground Fault Interrupter Receptacles", "TPDS - Duplex Switch"?
Weight and size: your variants are set to 2 lbs. The Cortech spec sheet does not give a weight. It gives the plate sizes (single gang 3.75” x 5.75”, double gang 5.75” x 5.75”) but not the depth.
Material: the spec sheet overview says polycarbonate, and the detailed specifications say a polycarbonate and nylon blend. I used the blend.
Hardware: the Cortech mounting instructions say the security screws and Nyloc nuts are supplied, and Tapcon concrete screws are used for concrete walls.
I left out the patent notes and the Cortech "About" text from your current page.
Collection links: Tiger Plates are only in your Cortech collection. I linked your Hardware for Behavioral Health Care Facilities and Prison & Detention Hardware & Equipment collections. Would you like Tiger Plates added to those collections?
Product images: the page has one image. The Cortech product page has a photo of each of the eight plate types. Would you like me to add them?
